items.summary: Verify and fix the admin authorization check logic in ProtectedAdminRoute.tsx that incorrectly denies access to authorized admin users, ensuring it properly validates admin status from the backend isCallerAdmin function before rendering the AdminDashboard

Add comprehensive error logging in AdminRegistration.tsx to capture the exact backend response and error details when the 'Registration failed' and 'Authorization Required' errors occur, helping identify the root cause of the authorization failure

Debug and fix the 'Access Denied' error shown in the uploaded screenshot (image-4.png) that displays 'You do not have permission to access the admin dashboard' with 'Authorization Required' and 'Registration failed' messages when attempting to access the admin dashboard

Fix the backend record validation error 'Invalid record {name:text; role:text; businessName:opt text; email:text; phoneNumber:text}; argument field role' shown at the bottom of the uploaded screenshot (image-4.png) in the AdminRegistration.tsx authentication flow
